chapter: Brass bands and the WPA band
title: The Onward band's return and Johnson's own brass band work
summary: Talk of the Onward band's return, then Johnson says he played with the Tuxedo brass band.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well they're bringing the Onward band back now.
Uh huh. That should be good. Maybe there'll be more work. I hope so. We were at the parade Saturday. Up at Tulane.
The Onward band was up there. The first job out.
The very first one. But you used to play in brass bands then too you said? Right at that.
I played the Ripper band. Most of the Tuxedo band. Now which Tuxedo is that? Papa Saris Band. The original.
